name: Incursion
source:
Incursion is a short yandere-themed adult erotic otome romance visual novel about spending the night getting to know your really really friendly uninvited houseguest. 

You're on your way home from a long day at work one typical Friday night when a chance encounter on the bus with a handsome stranger leads to an evening you'll never forget.

[From [url=https://sicfuk.itch.io/incursion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《入侵》是一部以病娇为主题的短篇成人色情乙女浪漫视觉小说，讲述的是花一夜时间去了解你真正友好的不速之客。

在一个典型的周五晚上，你结束了漫长的一天工作，在回家的路上，在公共汽车上偶然遇到了一位英俊的陌生人，这让你度过了一个永远不会忘记的夜晚。

[来自[url=https://sicfuk.itch.io/incursion]Itch.io[/url]]
